title: Strict department extraction schemas (ER, OPD, Dental)

test_cases.name: ER-specific schema fields presence
test_cases.expected_result: Primary survey (ABCDE) and patient_disposition fields present
test_cases.evidence: ER schema contains all primary survey and disposition fields (airway, breathing, circulation, disability, exposure)

test_cases.name: Dental procedure and consent fields
test_cases.expected_result: consent_obtained, tooth_number, and procedure fields present
test_cases.evidence: Dental schema enforces consent_obtained, tooth_number, procedure_executed, and materials_inventory

test_cases.name: OPD schema fields isolation
test_cases.expected_result: Contains comorbidities and follow-up timing; excludes ER ABCDE survey fields
test_cases.evidence: OPD schema contains comorbidities and follow_up_timing without ER primary survey fields

test_cases.name: Extra fields stripping
test_cases.expected_result: Extra field is ignored/stripped from output model
test_cases.evidence: Extra unrecognized field cleanly excluded from serialized model data

test_cases.name: Cross-department schema isolation
test_cases.input_setup: Query get_department_fields() for er, opd, and dental
test_cases.expected_result: Each department defines distinct, non-overlapping specialty schemas
test_cases.evidence: Department fields isolated across ER (22), OPD (17), Dental (22)
